results.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished horizontal 16:9 cover illustration for the Themes and Customization category of a console gaming website. One continuous cinematic scene: an elegant large television displays a vividly colored wallpaper landscape that seamlessly changes from a glowing emerald forest at left into a warm sunset island in the middle and a cool blue futuristic city at right. These worlds flow into each other as one imaginary landscape, without visible panel borders. Soft ribbons of colored light spill from the screen into the surrounding dark room, with a small abstract color wheel reflection on a glossy desk. Charcoal black and emerald-green illumination matches a dark gaming website. Full-bleed, polished realistic digital illustration, legible even at small card size. Keep television and all the artwork inside the canvas. No handheld console, no portable screen, no branded hardware, no game controller, no logos, no captions, no typography, no interface text, no grids, no collage of separate thumbnails. This is original decorative category artwork, not a screenshot.
